title: Hourly Auto-Dig:FED national security adviser and EOP location
summary: Dataset-first FED pass adding source-bounded White House compound geography, current-role evidence for Marco Rubio, a current NSC personnel transition, and a bounded formal-status follow-up.

sources.title: Greatest hits from Rubio's head-turning podcast interview
Scoop:Key W.H. national security aide Andy Baker is departing

data.research_question: Who currently holds the National Security Adviser role, what defensible public organizational geography can be attached to the associated EOP surface, and what current news materially updates that FED/NSC graph?
data.method: Enumerated the current dataset/topic universe; applied deterministic two-stage selection with last-three dataset/geography exclusions and an active-PR conflict exclusion; reviewed the FED target queue; checked first-party White House organizational/location pages; searched current reporting; created source-bounded typed records and a recursive target.
classification_rules: Dataset stage is approximately uniform over the full eligible pool after diversity exclusions.
Previous three successful hourly datasets were excluded:drunk-drivers, greater-israel, cia.
Previous-three dominant geographies Utah, Israel, and California were avoided.
The active ECFR/dark-academia hourly PR was excluded only as a direct-conflict avoidance rule.
White House compound/public mailing geography is not promoted to a separate component headquarters claim.
Current reporting can support holder identity while formal acting/permanent appointment status remains unresolved.
News is ingested only when it changes the personnel/event graph materially.

findings.selection_algorithm: sorted full pool -> remove previous-three datasets -> remove direct active-PR conflicts -> random.Random(seed).choice

findings.result: Exact whole-corpus actionable target count could not be reproduced in the connector-only runtime because the executable Free-Range corpus loader cannot be run over the complete repository tree; no count was fabricated.

White House primary material places senior EOP advisers in the West Wing and most EOP staff in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building, both within the White House compound. The public 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue address is recorded as compound/public-address geography, not as an inferred NSC-specific headquarters.
Recent reporting identifies Marco Rubio as current national security adviser; authoritative current formal acting/permanent appointment semantics remain unresolved.

findings.scope: Current reporting through 2026-08-19 for White House national security adviser / NSC personnel changes.
findings.result: Ingested the August 14, 2026 reported Andy Baker departure because it is a material current NSC personnel transition; skipped non-material commentary.

gaps: Exact whole-corpus actionable target count was not safely executable in the connector-only runtime.
Formal acting/permanent National Security Adviser designation remains unresolved.
